## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`); organisation owners and members can skip this
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, and a fix has a test that failed before it
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated if users will notice the change
- [ ] If a pinned digest under `tests/golden/` moved, `GOLDEN-CHANGELOG.md` has a row for it
